record.question: Which drug schedule deals with the list of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances, and drugs with high abuse potential?
record.explanation: Answer D: Schedule X. Schedule X under India’s Drugs Rules identifies specified drugs subject to stricter controls because of abuse/dependence risk. Source/context note: Narcotic and psychotropic substances are also governed by the NDPS Act and related rules; Schedule X is not a complete list of all such drugs. Reference: https://cdsco.gov.in/opencms/opencms/en/Acts-Rules/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
